lara: quick check — hitting a weird pip/poetry mismatch when I enable async streaming in the py SDK. poetry.lock has httpx 0.23 pinned but the streaming helper (async generator) behaves badly unless I have httpx 0.24+. Locally `pip install .` with an unconstrained httpx works, CI using `poetry install` fails at runtime with `AttributeError: AsyncByteStream has no attribute 'some_new'`

matt: do you have the exact traceback? 0.24 did change some internals around httpcore/httpx streaming. if possible, try `poetry add httpx@^0.24` and regen the lock. that usually fixes runtime mismatches. :thinking:

lara: trace is short, here's the relevant bit:
```
File "/opt/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/redwood_sdk/stream.py", line 78, in _stream_impl
  async for chunk in resp.aiter_bytes():
AttributeError: 'Response' object has no attribute 'aiter_bytes'
```
looks like the method naming changed in the httpx/httpcore split.

sophie: yep that lines up. we bumped httpx in some repos last quarter. two suggestions: 1) if you want to keep poetry, explicitly set httpx to ^0.24 in pyproject.toml and `poetry lock` locally then push the lockfile; or 2) in CI, install via exported requirements to avoid lock mismatch: `poetry export -f requirements.txt --without-hashes -o /tmp/reqs.txt && pip install -r /tmp/reqs.txt` — that lets you pin only the top-level deps but still use pip. both are common patterns.

priya: also watch typing stubs — bumping httpx pulled in typing-extensions 4.x and mypy started flagging `AsyncGenerator` vs `AsyncIterator` in a few places. if you have strict mypy in CI, add a bump for `types-requests` or adjust the annotations to `AsyncIterator[bytes]`. small annoyance but easy to patch.

lara: ah good call on mypy. our dev CI runs `mypy --ignore-missing-imports` so it caught nothing locally but GH actions enforces stricter config. i'll try explicit httpx ^0.24 + run mypy.

matt: one more note — if you change the SDK to support both versions, you can guard for both apis:
```python
# redwood_sdk/stream.py (compat shim)
try:
  aiter = resp.aiter_bytes
except AttributeError:
  aiter = getattr(resp, "aiter_raw", None) or getattr(resp, "aiter_bytes", None)
async for chunk in aiter():
  ...
```
not ideal long-term but buys time for customers pinned to older httpx.

lara: nice, i'll do a short PR with the shim + CI matrix that tests httpx 0.23 and 0.24 so we don't regress. also will include the poetry export step in the CI job as a fallback.

ci-bot: build job #1248 passed on branch lara/stream-httpx-compat :white_check_mark:

sophie: thanks — ping me for the code review when it's up, i'll run the matrix locally.

lara: will do. thanks all! :pray:
